crop.notes: The 'Theatre Comique' heading is clipped at the top; the unrelated 'Personal' item about John McCullough is included below.

title.suggested: Tom Allen Spars at the Theatre Comique

summary.suggested: The Missouri Republican reported that Tom Allen and the seconds of both principals in the late prize fight drew a crowded house for their boxing at the Theatre Comique, and would appear again that night.

metadata.notes: Running head reads 'The Missouri Republican, St. Louis, Friday, September 26, 1873' (page 4); it became the St. Louis Republic only in 1888.

facts.fact: Allen and the seconds from both sides of the recent prize fight boxed before a crowded house at the Theatre Comique, St. Louis

notes: Same benefit as 476; the 'late prize-ring exhibition' is Allen's fight of September 23, 1873.
